note: hook_post_action_example is the reference submodule of hook_post_action. It implements all 8 post-write hooks and logs to the 'hook_post_action_test' channel; it has no config/state of its own. Its only live 'state' is whether it is enabled, so execution cases are grounded in enabling/uninstalling the module (verified via drush pm:list and moduleHandler()->invokeAllWith to confirm the reference handler is/ isn't an active implementer of the post hooks). Introspection cases discover, on the live site, that it is the module implementing the hooks and the channel it logs to.

evals.prompt: What does the hook_post_action_example submodule do, and to which logger channel does it write?
evals.expected_output: It is a reference implementation of hook_post_action's hooks. On every entity/node insert/update/delete it logs a message via \Drupal::logger('hook_post_action_test'), so its messages appear under the 'hook_post_action_test' channel in dblog.

evals.prompt: Which hook_post_action hooks does the hook_post_action_example module implement?
evals.expected_output: All eight: hook_entity_postinsert/postupdate/postdelete/postsave and hook_node_postinsert/postupdate/postdelete/postsave. A single node insert therefore produces four log messages (node_postinsert, node_postsave, entity_postinsert, entity_postsave).

evals.prompt: How do I see the hook_post_action_example module in action after enabling it?
evals.expected_output: Enable hook_post_action_example, then add/update/delete content on the site (through the UI / a real web request), and view the log at admin/reports/dblog. You will see 'hook_post_action_test' messages for each entity operation. (The hooks dispatch on request shutdown.)

evals.prompt: On this live site, inspect the running module set and confirm which module implements hook_node_postinsert (a hook_post_action hook), and state its name.
evals.expected_output: hook_post_action_example implements hook_node_postinsert (discoverable via \Drupal::moduleHandler()->invokeAllWith('node_postinsert', ...) or by listing enabled modules and their implementations).

evals.prompt: The reference hook_post_action handler is enabled on this site. Inspect the live module code/config and report the exact logger channel string it uses for its messages.

I want to switch on the bundled reference handler that logs a message whenever content is created, updated or deleted. Enable the hook_post_action_example module so its post-save logging becomes active on this site.
evals.expected_output: hook_post_action_example is enabled (drush en hook_post_action_example), so it appears in the enabled module list and is an implementer of hook_entity_postinsert (invokeAllWith('entity_postinsert') includes it).

evals.prompt: The reference logging handler hook_post_action_example is currently enabled but we no longer want the post-save log noise. Uninstall the hook_post_action_example module (leave the parent hook_post_action in place).
evals.expected_output: hook_post_action_example is no longer enabled (drush pmu hook_post_action_example), so it is absent from the enabled module list and no longer an implementer of the post hooks, while hook_post_action itself remains enabled.
